import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *
from harness import Raw
# relay with empty allowed list
C0 = cfg(peers=[{"id":"edge","mode":"access","accounts":[]},{"id":"relay","mode":"relay","accounts":[]}])
check("relay empty allowed", env(C0, [ev(0,"relay",None,"internal",basic_req(frm="sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t",extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:alice@lab.test>")]))]), ["identity"])
# 4 pai items
check("pai 4 items", env(cfg(), [ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req(extra=[("P-Asserted-Identity","<sip:a@x.test>"),("P-Asserted-Identity","<tel:+1>"),("P-Asserted-Identity","<tel:+2>")]))]), ["fields"])
# ppi single tel
check("ppi single tel", env(cfg(), [ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req(extra=[("P-Preferred-Identity","<tel:+12025550100>")]))]),
      [{"decision":"accept","identity":"tel:+12025550100","pai":["tel:+12025550100"],"from":"tel:+12025550100"}])
# anon target
C = cfg()
check("anon target", env(C, [ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req(uri="sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid",to="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"))]),
      [{"decision":"accept","target":"sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"}])
# equal-time ledger
check("equal times", env(C, [ev(5,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req()), ev(5,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req())]),
      [{"decision":"accept","first":0},{"decision":"replay","first":0}])
# wire total exactly at cap is valid: use 300 events of ~27962 bytes
big = cfg()
body_len = 27962 - 200
evs = []
for i in range(300):
    evs.append(ev(i,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req(cid="c%d"%i, body=b"x"*body_len)))
tot = sum(len(e["wire_hex"])//2 for e in evs)
p = run(env(big, evs))
print("wire total", tot, "rc", p.returncode, "live", json.loads(p.stdout)["live"] if p.returncode==0 else None)
if not (tot <= 8388608 and p.returncode == 0):
    FAILS.append(("wire cap boundary", tot, p.returncode))
# one byte over the total
evs.append(ev(300,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req(cid="cz", body=b"x")))
p = run(env(big, evs))
print("wire over cap rc", p.returncode)
if p.returncode != 2: FAILS.append(("wire over cap", p.returncode))
# wire_hex exactly 131072 chars
p = run(env(big, [ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",basic_req(body=b"x"*65536)[:0] or b"")]))
# (envelope rejects: 65536 bytes -> 131072 chars ok, but request>65536 handled below)
req = b"MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=a\r\nTo: <sip:bob@lab.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\n"
body = b"x"*(65536-len(req)-4)
full = req + b"Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n" % len(body) + body
print("req len", len(full))
p = run(env(big, [ev(0,"edge","alice","internal",full)]))
print("max-size request rc", p.returncode, json.loads(p.stdout)["results"] if p.returncode==0 else p.stderr[:200])
if p.returncode != 0: FAILS.append(("maxsize", p.returncode))
sys.exit(summary())
PYEOF
